Initial release: batch resume screening using ZhiPu GLM-V model

- Screens and compares multiple resumes (PDF/DOCX/TXT/URL) against custom criteria.
- Outputs a detailed Markdown table with pass/fail results and reasoning for each candidate.
- Supports both URL and local (PDF) resume files; local PDFs auto-converted to images.
- Requires `ZHIPU_API_KEY` setup; detailed instructions for configuration included.
- CLI options for criteria, model, custom prompt, output format (Markdown/JSON), and error handling.
- Clear rules to always display the full screening table, not just a summary.
